statement: HPE fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was $12.2 billion, up 34% year-over-year, with the Cloud and AI segment at $9 billion (up 25.4%) and servers at $6.8 billion (up 35.3%).
why: Segment revenue growth confirms AI system shipments are actually converting to revenue rather than sitting in backlog.

impact.mechanism: Rising server and AI segment revenue reflects delivered accelerator-bearing systems, indicating sustained component offtake.

evidence.source: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. (SEC EDGAR 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
evidence.excerpt: Record revenue of $12.2 billion, up 34% year-over-year.

confidence.basis: Secondary trade-press account of a reported quarter; the same headline figure is echoed by HPE's filed release but was read here from the article.
